theme.title: Rotation: Growth → Value & Defensives
theme.summary: Materials (+2.04%) and Real Estate (+1.87%) led the market today, while Energy (-3.96%) and Technology (-3.28%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -0.63% versus +0.62% for defensives and +0.56% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +0.41% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -1.09%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up -0.22%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 9.83% to 21.35, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 1.16% to $3,955.30, crude oil was little changed at $95.99, and bitcoin slipped 1.86% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
